name: Scout
outcome: A trade, watch or avoid verdict for any Polymarket market, with the reasons: liquidity, spread, recent activity, time left, price and how clear the resolution rules are.
inputs: market: a Polymarket market link, slug or condition id
privacy: Only the market reference is used. Nothing is stored beyond the payment receipt.
failurePolicy: A market that is closed or not found is refused before any payment is taken.
